ppi_component_rule: canonical ascending PPI component IDs: component 0 for the five-dataset experiment and IDs 0..294 for full PPI

process_timing_semantics.prover_wall_time_seconds: 整个独立 Prover 子进程生命周期墙钟时间，含启动与 I/O，不与原生在线计时混合
process_timing_semantics.verify_wall_time_seconds: 整个独立 Verifier 子进程生命周期墙钟时间，含启动与 I/O，不与原生在线计时混合

process_warmup: each prover process performs an untimed CUDA NTT/INTT plus ephemeral non-SRS non-stable MSM warmup before proof counters; actual SRS/KZG bases remain cold until commitment timing

timing_semantics.commitment_time_ms: cold native KZG commitment work only, including first-use static-base preparation invoked inside commitment; Taylor-shift coefficient materialization is excluded
timing_semantics.proof_size_bytes: actual canonical serialized mechanism proof bytes
timing_semantics.prove_time_ms: native online proof work, Taylor-shift coefficient materialization, and canonical proof encoding, excluding KZG commitment work and artifact file I/O
